description: ShanghaiRanking Global Ranking of Academic Subjects (GRAS): for a subject (55, e.g. Mathematics, Computer Science, Clinical Medicine, Economics) and year, ranked universities with rank or band, total score, the five indicator scores, country and institution URL. Filter by country or university name. Without a subject, lists the subjects and their codes. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Optional country/region as ShanghaiRanking writes it, e.g. United States, China, Türkiye

subject.description: Subject name or code, e.g. Mathematics or AS0101 (omit to list subjects)

university.description: Optional part of a university name

year.description: Ranking year, 2017 to 2026 (default: newest for the subject)

name: search_shanghai_gras_rankings
title: Search Shanghai Gras Rankings
